simple.meaning: יַקִּיר (yaqqîyr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “noble, rare.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Ezra, Daniel, beginning at Ezra 4:10. Its contexts include kingship, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יַקִּיר (H3358).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: יַקִּיר (yaqqîyr) / H3358 is traced through Ezra 4:10, Daniel 2:11 as a generated source-based concept entry.
